proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VIII Section 807, what is the minimum floor area and minimum horizontal dimension required for a habitable room in a Group A dwelling?

options.text: 6.00 sq.m floor area with a 2.00 m minimum horizontal dimension
9.00 sq.m floor area with a 2.40 m minimum horizontal dimension
4.50 sq.m floor area with a 1.80 m minimum horizontal dimension
7.50 sq.m floor area with a 2.10 m minimum horizontal dimension

proposed.rationale: Section 807 requires habitable rooms in Group A dwellings to have at least 6.00 sq.m of floor area and a minimum horizontal dimension of 2.00 m. Smaller service spaces (kitchen, bath/toilet) are governed by separate minimum areas.
proposed.explanation: The 6.00 sq.m / 2.00 m habitable-room pair is the most common exam target; the 2.00 m minimum horizontal dimension ensures a usable rectangular footprint even when the area is at minimum.
